snippet.title: DATA DUTY | OFFICIAL TRAILER
snippet.description:
"THAT'S NOT WHAT I MEANT BY FIREWALL!!!!!"

CONGRATULATIONS on your new position as Chief Technology Officer of Dubitably Data! Reports of increased cyberattacks have surged. Your job is to defend the company's data at all times against waves of disasters ranging from physical, digital, and social threats.

Learn about cybersecurity as you survive cyber-based disasters, complete objectives, explore, and interact with the custom 3D office environment! All in a fun little indie game!

Remember the CIA Triad!

Good luck out there, and Dubitably Data is in your hands!

————————————————————————————

Check out DATA DUTY on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3953070/DATA_DUTY/
